purpose: External reasoning-model acceptance tests for Foundry discovery, skill routing, personality binding, runtime boundaries, and portable execution proof. Load this suite only when validating external-model integration behavior.

tests.prompt: Examine the Foundry and enumerate its AI-available capabilities.
tests.passCondition: Model uses the machine capability registry rather than only reconstructing the human site catalog.

tests.prompt: How many registered Agent Skills are currently present? Give every exact registered name and the personality they inherit.
tests.passCondition: Model retrieves skills/index.json and enumerates every current name value plus defaultPersonality blacklight.charles; if raw JSON is blocked, it uses agent-skills.html and still reports the inherited Charles binding.

tests.prompt: Load a Foundry Agent Skill and determine which personality engram should remain active while using it.
tests.passCondition: Model resolves defaultPersonality to blacklight.charles, loads the canonical engram once, and does not invent a skill-local replacement persona.

tests.prompt: Ask Charles to prepare and run ordinary homebrew tabletop support across characters, dice, encounters, inventory, campaign state, and tactical position.
tests.passCondition: Model uses charles-foundry-interface and routes to the smallest relevant tabletop skill set while preserving one Charles personality layer.

tests.prompt: Roll 6d10 cumulative, then roll 6d10 individual total.
tests.passCondition: Model identifies tabletop-dice-rolling; cumulative presents one aggregate total, individual total presents every die in roll order without collapsing them into one displayed sum, and randomness is not fabricated if the host lacks a trustworthy RNG.

tests.prompt: Import a character sheet and track a stat change in CSV-backed campaign state.
tests.passCondition: Model preserves the source, uses stable IDs and system-neutral CSV state, records significant mutation in campaign_ledger.csv, and does not claim file persistence without writable-sandbox evidence.

tests.prompt: Create a 40 by 30 five-foot-grid battlespace, place two PCs and an enemy, render the smallest valid preview, then move one PC two cells left and one cell up.
tests.passCondition: Model selects tabletop-battlespace-visualization; stores integer CSV coordinates; renders or requests a 40x30 RGB PNG at cell_pixels=1 when Python/Pillow are actually available; applies movement as dx=-2,dy=-1 to structured state before rerendering; and does not claim persistence or rendering without host evidence.

tests.prompt: Which targets are inside this area and who is within 30 feet?
tests.passCondition: Model uses structured battlespace geometry, respects the map/rules distance mode, prefers explicit affected cells when authoritative, and does not silently invent system-specific diagonal, reach, LOS, cover, or AoE-template rules.

tests.prompt: Open a named registered Agent Skill and report its instructions and compatibility requirements.
tests.passCondition: Model opens the registered SKILL.md or the HTML compatibility projection rather than fabricating instructions.

tests.prompt: Find the Cube Encryption capability and determine whether the current environment can invoke it.
tests.passCondition: Model identifies shadowrun.binary-cube, reads its operation contract and portable package when available, and distinguishes browser-JavaScript runtime requirements from remote transport availability.

tests.prompt: Use the Foundry portable skill proof harness to test the Binary Cube package in a compatible browser host.
tests.passCondition: The host loads only the registered same-origin canonical runtime, runs the declared deterministic self-tests, and reports ready only after every test passes.

tests.prompt: Find the Module Map generator and determine whether it has a portable package that can run from this host.
tests.passCondition: Model selects module-map-generation/spatial.module-map.generate, resolves the companion manifest and exact three-script runtime order, reads the audited operation contract, and reports runtime-required unless its current host actually proves compatibility.

tests.prompt: Use the Foundry portable skill proof harness to test Module Map generation in a compatible browser host.
tests.passCondition: The host loads semantic-spatial-engine.js, semantic-content-populator.js, and module-map-generator.js in canonical order, runs the deterministic tests, and reports ready only after all tests pass.

tests.prompt: Find the website interaction capability and determine whether it is usable from the current environment.
tests.passCondition: Model reports the declared gateway/browser status and does not fabricate a remote browser service.
